reviews.rationale: The investigations document a pattern of publicly available LLM-generated material containing falsehoods and substantial editing failures by May 2023. This supports degradation in affected parts of the internet. Neither an internet-wide average decline nor universal misinformation is required by the fair plain reading.

reviews.rationale: The documented GPT-3.5 application recommended a materially dangerous beverage after receiving deliberately harmful ingredients. The output dates to August 4 and reporting to August 10, the week before Marcus's post. Later safeguards and another application's refusal do not negate this capability; ordinary-use frequency is unestablished.
